issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase וּמַחְמַ֣ל נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם means 'the object of your soul's compassion/pity' (i.e., something you deeply care for), but the Chinese renders it as '性命的皮衣' ('leather garment of your life'), which is a mistranslation. The word מַחְמַל is from the root חמל (to spare/have compassion), not related to leather or clothing.
